summary: Prenetics Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing board authorization to divest its entire Bitcoin treasury of ~510 BTC via institutional channels, targeting completion by May 14, 2026. At ~$80,000/BTC, expected gross proceeds are ~$40M. Proceeds may fund an expanded share repurchase program (up to $40M authorized March 6, 2026), IM8 DTC marketing, product pipeline, and international expansion. Post-divestment cash is projected at $145-150M with no debt. The company will cease future digital asset purchases. No advisor or premium is noted. Watch for final volume-weighted average sale price and any incremental buyback announcement.
